chunks: Ahmad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Jareer Al-Rawwasy, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hassan Musa (peace be upon him), and he was saying: 'O Allah! I ask You for rest at the time of death, and pardon at the time of reckoning,' repeating it.

key_terms.الْعَفْوَ: Pardon, forgiveness, or exemption from punishment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) say to ask for ease at death and pardon at reckoning?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication from Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) highlights the spiritual preparation for the two pivotal transitions of the soul: the ease of death (al-rahah) and the mercy sought during the accounting (al-hisab). It reflects the Shia emphasis on seeking divine facilitation at the threshold of the grave and the scales of justice, reinforcing the believer's reliance on Allah's grace during these critical moments.
